gui.justreactors.mode.passive_tooltip: Passive Mode: outputs FE directly via Reactor Power Taps. Add a Coolant Port to switch to Active Steam mode.
gui.justreactors.mode.active_tooltip: Active Mode (Coolant Port installed): boils Water into Steam for Turbines instead of generating FE directly.
gui.justreactors.heat_tooltip: Passive FE scales with casing temp. Active mode boils Water > 100 °C. Fuel above 1,000 °C burns slightly faster.
gui.justreactors.rpm_tooltip: Current: %s RPM (Peak coil efficiency around 900 & 1,800 RPM)
tooltip.justreactors.reactor_controller: Brain of the Reactor multiblock (3x3x3 to 32x32x32).
tooltip.justreactors.reactor_coolant_por: Right-click to toggle Water Inlet / Steam Outlet. Click with a Water Bucket to fill.
tooltip.justreactors.turbine_controller: Brain of the Steam Turbine multiblock (min 5x4x5).
tooltip.justreactors.turbine_fluid_port: Right-click to toggle Steam Inlet / condensed Water Outlet.
tooltip.justreactors.turbine_redstone_po: Configurable Redstone automation port for Steam Turbines.
tooltip.justreactors.cyanite_reprocessor: Reprocesses 2 Cyanite + 1,000 mB Water + 20,000 FE into 1 Blutonium Ingot.
gui.justreactors.turbine.vent_tooltip: Controls excess condensed Water: Overflow voids extra water when full, All dumps all water immediately, Disabled stalls steam intake if the tank is full.

message.justreactors.control_rod_top_onl: Control Rod at (%s, %s, %s) must be on the top face.

message.justreactors.missing_fuel_rod: Expected Reactor Fuel Rod at (%s, %s, %s) below Control Rod.

message.justreactors.invalid_interior_bl: Shell block at (%s, %s, %s) cannot be inside the reactor.

message.justreactors.turbine.missing_bea: Turbine is missing a Rotor Bearing.
message.justreactors.turbine.extra_shaft: Unexpected Rotor Shaft outside main axis at (%s, %s, %s).
message.justreactors.turbine.invalid_int: Shell block at (%s, %s, %s) cannot be inside the turbine.
message.justreactors.turbine.no_blades: Turbine must have at least one Rotor Blade.
jei.justreactors.info.reactor_controller: Brain of the Reactor multiblock (3x3x3 to 32x32x32). Edges must be Reactor Casing; vertical Fuel Rod columns must be topped by Control Rods. Add a Reactor Coolant Port to switch to Active Steam mode.
jei.justreactors.info.reactor_coolant_po: Right-click to toggle between Water Inlet and Steam Outlet. Adding at least one Coolant Port switches a Reactor to Active Cooling for Steam Turbines.
jei.justreactors.info.turbine_controller: Brain of the Steam Turbine multiblock (min 5x4x5). Place one Rotor Bearing on a wall with a straight Rotor Shaft to the opposite wall, Rotor Blades along the shaft, and metal/gem Coils around the shaft.
jei.justreactors.info.turbine_redstone_p: Controls a Steam Turbine via Redstone (ON/OFF, Coils, Analog Steam Flow) or emits Redstone based on RPM or Energy Buffer thresholds.
jei.justreactors.info.cyanite_reprocesso: Reprocesses 2 Cyanite Ingots, 1,000 mB Water, and 20,000 FE into 1 Blutonium Ingot, which can fuel a Reactor again.
